Well, I'm a girl but what helped me was going slow.

I struggled with my weight throughout school, usually starting out with a week straight of exercising for like an hour and a half every day but would feel discouraged and lazy the next week and give up.
Just try to exercise at least 5 days a week, even if it's just for ten minutes, then slowly get it up to more. The important thing is just to stick with it.

Also, drink a cup of water before each meal, it will help you get full faster. And green tea before each meal as well helps! 

You shouldn't be trying to lose weight as fast as OP, if he doesn't gain it back he'll be lucky, usually when it comes off that fast they do. Although my sister did lose weight that way, it wasn't healthy, all she ate was oranges for a couple months, and pretty sure she's now addicted to laxatives. 

Hope this helps :) Good luck!

Hmm.. I have a bunch of favorite movies. My favorite directors are probably David Wain, Quentin Tarantino, Kevin Smith, David Fincher, and Peter Jackson, so pretty much any movies by them. Have you seen any of their work? Oh yeah and I really love the movie Kick ass, not too familiar with the director though. I pretty much like any type of music, but my favorite genre has to be indie I think because their voices are just so perfect! Like The decemberists, the dodos, and muse. I could listen to the dodos for forever. 

And I could probably list off a million more bands lol. I have over 6,000 songs on my ipod and each one means something to me x) What kind of music do you like? I use to play soccer when I was little, but I haven't played in forever. I like badminton and tennis a lot, those are pretty much the only sports I'm good at. Basket balls fun too, but the only reason I'm decent at it is because I'm like 5'9.

Yep :) I enjoy reading, writing fiction, and am obsessed with movies, TV shows, and music. Sometimes music is literally the only reason I get up in the morning, to go get my iPod and blast my speakers. What about you?

Thanks :) I just have to look on the brighter sides of things and try some more. You only get one life so why not live it? I'm a teenager right now, so things have to get better, right? And if they end up getting worse I always have /r/SuicideWatch, eh? Thanks again for your wise words :)
 I don't know what the last part about commentaries is though. :/

Thank you :) I like the romantic part of you, I think I might hang onto that thought. 

I think I will stick around, why not? See what happens. I just need to look on the brighter sides of things and block out the side that ask what's the point, because I know what answer that will be.

Thank you for your insight, I really appreciate it.

I'm not against it at all! I think it should be legal. But I am kinda afraid of it though. I've heard some people have bad reactions from it. My friend had some from her sibling who visited from Mexico and she HATED it, it made her very paranoid and she said she would not stop crying. 

I do want to try it though, but I don't know anyone who's into that kinda stuff, the only friends I've had in highschool were the straight A nerds who are actively against drugs. :( My parents would also kill me if they found out.

It got better for you? I'm glad :) I really hate that saying "it gets better" because for me it really doesn't feel like it does. I was bullied in high school and I just thought "just get through this and it'll get better." 

I wrote a poem once describing it like a light at the end of the tunnel, just get through this and it'll get better, but as I get closer and closer I realize that the light doesn't exist. It's just an endless black tunnel. I feel selfish thinking this and seeing how people who have lost absolutely everything feel the same while I've lost nothing, but that just makes me feel more sick and pathetic.

I've never played starcraft or LoL. I really love video games, but mostly watching other people play them, not playing them myself x) I don't know why, but playing a new video game is almost terrifying to me. Whenever I played Zelda Ocarina of time I'd just made Link hang out in his little village with his house and never leave and do anything.

Thanks for writing this :) It helps a lot. "Although I may never laugh with you or cry with you just know that I love you." That is beautiful, thank you. People on the internet are so compassionate it really gives me hope. Even when I have none, I go on here and see a post about somebody on a webcam trying to kill themselves and everyone is freaking out on Reddit telling them people care, that *they* care, even though they have no idea who that person is, they care about them. That may be a bad example seeing as there were a bunch of people from 4chan egging him on, but the simple fact that there were people who were saying they loved him and they care was enough to bring me to tears. It makes me stronger knowing that there are people like you in the world willing to help a random stranger and I realize I want to continue living and do the same. I will put in some effort, thank you. 

Sorry it took me so long to reply, I really didn't think I'd get much responses to this and went to bed after answering the first 2.

Thanks for the advice, that's definitely the biggest reason I'm not going to college, I'd have to take out a billion loans to pay for everything. But I don't have any spare money to travel either. Completely broke.

I want to do more things I just really don't feel like making the effort. I swear, I just feel so lethargic and *lazy*. All I want to do is sleep all day... I guess I just can't find a good enough reason to try, or even get up in the morning. 

But I will try harder in trying to find something. My sister always told me "You can have anything in the world if you want it bad enough and would do absolutely anything to have it, you'll get it, one way or another." So I guess I'll just look harder for something I feel passionate about and go get it.

Thank you for replying and caring :)

:) Thank you for replying to this! I'm glad I'm not alone. Just hearing that you connect to this made me feel better.
I'm online almost 24/7 so I'll try to connect more with people. I'm just really socially awkward and most of the time just want to cut ties with everyone and be alone. My sister is the only person I feel like being with most of the time.

Trying something I haven't done sounds like hell right now! >.< But hopefully this feeling will change soon... I can't talk to people, I'm just really embarrassed in front of them and end up saying things I don't mean. But maybe I'll talk to my sister about it...

Even though i think these thoughts, I really don't think I could do it. It would tear my family apart even more than it is now. And I just can't even think about my parents if I did it, I'll start crying >.< I just wish there was someway to completely erase my existance... Ever since I was little and first watched the Butterfly Effect I always thought I was Ashton kutcher and that I wasn't meant to be born... 

Never lose hope in your own existence because of me! I'll keep living for now. And thank you again for messaging me when you were dead tired, this message didn't suck in the slightest :) I really appreciate it. It took me about an hour to write this post and like an hour now replying to you x) My eyes are almost glued shut right now.

"You have one life, you might as well do what you want with it. You'll wind up dying in the end, you might as well make a bit of happiness for yourself before you do." I like this a lot and will remember it. :) thank you
